plugins.name: liminalarc-creative-department
plugins.description:
The LiminalArc Creative Department â Morgan (chief-of-staff orchestrator) plus the full team (Brandon, Max, Stacy, Eddie, and future additions) and the LiminalArc brand reference library. Call on Morgan to orchestrate end-to-end projects, or invoke any team skill directly for one-off tasks. Morgan accepts assignments via inbox folder drops or directly in chat, and plans custom workflows for assignments outside the two standard pathways.

The team:

Morgan, Orchestrator â Plans the workflow, picks the right team for each assignment, runs projects end-to-end. Single point of contact.

Brandon, Strategist â Turns source material into content briefs. Runs the AIO research pipeline (buyer prompts â LLM testing â content gap analysis â post planning). Identifies the anchoring LiminalArc Principle and positioning angle for each piece.

Max, Copywriter â Writes short-form social and LinkedIn copy. Generates paired visual concepts for text posts. Iterates opening hooks when they're not landing.

Stacy, Technical Writer â Writes all long-form content: blog posts (POV, Practice Insight, How-To), position papers, white papers, and AIO-pipeline posts optimized for LLM citation.

Eddie, Editor â Reviews content against the LiminalArc brand standard (Style Book, Messaging Checklist, Principles). Runs the analysis-and-rewrite loop until 'Decision: Publish.'

Poppy, Designer â Owns PowerPoint and visual presentation work. Builds, polishes, rebrands, and QA-checks decks on the LiminalArc brand template â both masters, 30 layouts, 72 Creative Content layouts, 12 table styles, 6 infographics. Four shapes of deck work: brand check, polish, rebrand, build from outline.

What's new (most recent at top):
â¢ 0.4.1 â Wired the liminalarc-pptx skill into the plugin's brand canon: it now reads Copy Rules/Style Book.md and Messaging/LiminalArc Principles.md from the plugin's bundled reference/ for any work that touches slide text or messaging, alongside its own internal references for PowerPoint mechanics (layouts, placeholders, designer rules). Working-directory reference files remain additive. Brings the new skill in line with the v0.3.0 convention applied to the other team skills.
â¢ 0.4.0 â Added Poppy, the new Designer team member. Ships the liminalarc-pptx skill (v3.3) â the complete LiminalArc PowerPoint brand system: both masters, 30 layouts, 72 Creative Content layouts (cards / grids / long-text), 12 table styles, 6 infographic layouts, plus designer rules, QA checklist, and the copy-then-fill build workflow. Brand template assets (LiminalArc Template.pptx, Creative Content Layouts.pptx, Tables + Infographics.pptx) bundled with the skill. Workflow routing and a ready-to-use prompt library added under reference/Design Rules/.
â¢ 0.3.2 â Replaced the org-chart skill-name list with capability descriptions for each team member. Cleaner read in the plugin card and more useful for someone deciding what the plugin actually does.
â¢ 0.3.1 â First pass at a team org chart (replaced in 0.3.2 with capability descriptions).

plugins.name: liminalarc-sales-department
plugins.description:
The LiminalArc Sales Department â the start of an agentic sales workforce for LiminalArc Growth. Currently ships one skill: value-creation-briefing, which generates polished Word-document prep briefings for sales and executive conversations. Briefings pull proof points from your Low Fat Case Study (LFCS) repository to ground every pitch in real client outcomes. Future releases will add a chief-of-staff orchestrator (similar to Morgan and Ziggy in the Creative Department plugins) plus skills for account research, outreach drafting, follow-up notes, and pipeline review.

The team:

Value Creation Briefing â Generates a two-to-three-page .docx prep document for a sales or executive conversation. Confirms LFCS folder access, captures the meeting context (company, attendees, agenda), mines proof points from Draft / Final / Completed LFCS folders, weaves them into a structured briefing (stats header, prospect context, named players, strategic context, lead narrative, wedges to listen for, proof points, 90-day path forward, how-we-work promises, conversation hooks, recommended LiminalArc attendees).

What's new (most recent at top):
â¢ 0.1.1 â Specified the value-creation-briefing intake as a single elicitation form (six question groups: folder access, players at the table, prospect interest, meeting type + date, LiminalArc attendees, supporting docs) so the skill asks for everything at once instead of conversationally. The skill now also pre-scans the session's mounted folders before asking â if LFCS and the Client Pre-Sales Documents folder are already connected, the folder-access question is omitted. If a Client Pre-Sales Documents/{Company}/ subfolder already exists, its contents are pulled in as additive context for the new briefing.
â¢ 0.1.0 â Initial release. Single skill (value-creation-briefing) plus empty reference/ stub for shared sales materials to come. No orchestrator yet; skills are invoked directly by intent (e.g., 'prep me for the Acme call').
